ARABIC — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Conversational skills.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Conversational skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational skills.

2. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.

   A. Avoid speaking to classmates

   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

   D. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.

8. When practising Listening for gist: Main idea., which approach is best? (1 mark)

----
